title: Soy squid with mangetout
summary: Soy squid with mangetout is a japanese dinner built around squid rings and mangetout, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Soy squid with mangetout chopped before the pan goes on. Pat squid rings dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook squid rings until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook mangetout and carrots until hot and lightly browned. Return squid rings and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Soy squid with mangetout, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Soy squid with mangetout before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
